brief: Today's UPSC Intelligence Briefing covering key developments in Polity, Defense, Environment, Economy, and International Relations.

articles.title: National Green Hydrogen Mission: Advances in Domestic Electrolyser Manufacturing
articles.summary: India expands domestic electrolyser manufacturing capacity under the SIGHT scheme to reduce green hydrogen production costs.
prelims: Strategic Interventions for Green Hydrogen Transition (SIGHT) scheme is implemented by MNRE.
Electrolysers split water into hydrogen and oxygen using renewable electricity.
India targets producing 5 MMT of Green Hydrogen annually by 2030.
articles.mains: Use as an example of India's energy transition strategies and industrial policy supporting Net Zero goals by 2070.

articles.title: High-Level Panel Recommendations on Simultaneous Elections (One Nation, One Election)
articles.summary: Union Cabinet reviews draft constitutional amendments to synchronize Lok Sabha and State Assembly elections.
prelims: Article 83 and Article 172 govern the duration of Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies respectively.
Requires Constitutional Amendment under Article 368 with ratification by half of the states.
Law Commission (170th Report, 1999) first formally recommended simultaneous elections.
articles.mains: Critical analysis of federalism, electoral expenses, administrative stability, and democratic accountability.

articles.title: Defense Acquisition Council Approves Capital Acquisition for Next-Gen Frigates
articles.summary: The DAC clears Acceptance of Necessity (AoN) for indigenous stealth frigates to enhance naval security in the Indian Ocean Region.
prelims: Defense Acquisition Council (DAC) is chaired by the Union Defense Minister.
Acceptance of Necessity (AoN) is the initial step in the defense procurement process.
Focuses on Buy (Indian-Indigenously Designed, Developed, and Manufactured) category.
articles.mains: Illustrative case study for defense indigenization, Atmanirbhar Bharat in defense technology, and maritime domain awareness in the IOR.

articles.title: India-Nordic-Baltic 8 (NB8) Cooperation in Digital Infrastructure and Arctic Research
articles.summary: India deepens bilateral ties with NB8 nations prioritizing green technology transfer and India's Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI).
prelims: NB8 consists of Denmark, Estonia, Finland, Iceland, Latvia, Lithuania, Norway, and Sweden.
India's Arctic Policy emphasizes sustainable development and climate research.
Nordic countries are key global leaders in renewable energy, tech innovation, and circular economy models.
articles.mains: Useful for international relations questions regarding multi-alignment, Arctic governance, and DPI diplomacy.

articles.title: Project Dolphin Phase-II: Integrated Conservation Strategy for Freshwater Species
articles.summary: MoEFCC rolls out community-led conservation frameworks to protect the Ganges River Dolphin and its habitat.
prelims: Ganges River Dolphin (Platanista gangetica) is India's National Aquatic Animal.
IUCN Status: Endangered; listed under Schedule I of the Wildlife Protection Act, 1972.
Dolphins act as reliable bio-indicators of the overall health of river ecosystems.
articles.mains: Highlight in questions on biodiversity conservation, eco-restoration, and community-based environmental stewardship.
